proprietor_message.heading: From the Proprietor
paragraphs: ⟨Open by welcoming parents, guardians and invited guests to the ceremony, and by thanking Allah for bringing the set to this day.⟩
⟨Speak to what this class has carried: the secular curriculum alongside Islamic and Arabic education, and the discipline of complete Qur'an memorization that sets a Sultan Hanafi child apart.⟩
⟨Acknowledge the teachers, the boarding staff and the parents whose sacrifice made the years possible.⟩
⟨Close with a charge to the graduands and a prayer for the road ahead.⟩

head_teacher_message.heading: From the Head Teacher
paragraphs: ⟨Reflect on the academic year: results, competitions entered, and the character of this particular set.⟩
⟨Name the milestones worth remembering — the laboratories, the workshop, the Spelling Leaders competition, the annual awards.⟩
⟨Send them off with counsel they can carry into secondary or tertiary study.⟩
